summary: The productization goal is complete for v0.8.0 Beta. The repository now delivers a Chinese, Profile-driven, read-only Unreal Editor Static Mesh audit plugin with realistic Demo generation, current visual evidence, deterministic team reports, a recoverable installer, a verified clean release archive, reproducible UE 5.8.1 host evidence, and a public GitHub Release.
evidence: The Chinese README first screen presents the product, verified host, downloadable binary, installation guide, recording script, production screenshot, and engineering depth
Ten practical Static Mesh policies are driven by versioned Profiles; C++ collects Unreal facts while Python owns evaluation, task orchestration, sessions, comparison, and handoff
Versioned Profile, Issue, Evidence, Report, task-state, handoff, benchmark, session, comparison, and release contracts preserve provenance and evidence boundaries
The native Slate panel covers rule selection, complete asset ledger, issue evidence, search, running/cancelling states, regression comparison, JSON access, and team export

The deterministic Demo generator creates 24 project Static Mesh copies from local Engine content plus explicit naming, directory, collision, and Lightmap faults without redistributing or modifying Engine source assets
Fifteen current visuals cover rule selection, pass/problem states, collision, Lightmap, naming, directory, regression, running, cancelling, and standalone Chinese handoff output
63 automated tests and Ruff pass; UE_5.8.1-v0.8.0-release1 BuildPlugin completed UHT, C++ compilation, linking, and Win64 packaging
The release allowlist contains 32 payload files and excludes Intermediate, PDB, pycache, tests, runtime caches, generated Demo uassets, and development-machine absolute paths
Two archive writes from identical input produced the same ZIP hash; the final archive SHA-256 is cd700ecc4501420227b6181abf2e6e1b6850d3528a8ca7da446ce2fa8a16c1f1

A fresh project install and a backed-up upgrade each launched an independent UE 5.8.1 process, opened the production tab entry, ran packaged Python and real C++ collection for Engine Cube, and wrote a real Report
Recoverable uninstall removed the plugin and project enablement while preserving plugin and uproject backups; both owned Unreal PIDs exited without residual processes
GitHub Release v0.8.0 is public as a prerelease with ZIP, SHA-256, and manifest assets; GitHub reports the ZIP digest as sha256:cd700ecc4501420227b6181abf2e6e1b6850d3528a8ca7da446ce2fa8a16c1f1
knownLimits: Recorded compatibility is Windows 11, Win64, and Unreal Engine 5.8.1 only
The release is Beta and not a signed Marketplace submission
One C++ collection batch remains a synchronous boundary; no production-scale no-stall claim is made
Visible manual clicking, docking, and video capture follow the supplied recording script and are not claimed by hidden automation
The plugin intentionally performs no asset mutation, automatic repair, AI, or PCG generation
